refinements.name: 卓卓千华
refinements.description: 队伍中任意角色通过[快速支援]、[连携技]、[招架支援]、[回避支援]入场时，为装备者回复5点能量，5秒内最多触发一次；装备者消耗25点或以上能量时，全队角色造成的伤害提升10%，最多叠加2层，持续20秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间，该效果全队唯一。
refinements.descriptionEn: When any squad member enters the field through a Quick Assist, Chain Attack, Defensive Assist, or Evasive Assist, the equipper gains 5 Energy. This effect can trigger once every 5s. When the equipper consumes 25 or more Energy, the DMG dealt by all squad members increases by 10%, stacking up to 2 times, and lasting 20s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Only one instance of this effect can exist in the same squad.

basic.name: 普通攻击：《随想曲》
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多三段的攻击，造成以太伤害；
第三段攻击期间，可长按 【普通攻击键】 进行蓄力，持续聚集敌人，提升攻击范围，释放更加强力的攻击；
其他招式发动后，可长按 【普通攻击键】 直接发动第三段攻击。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Perform up to three attacks forward, dealing Ether DMG.
During the 3rd hit, hold [Basic Attack] to charge, drawing enemies in and expanding the attack range for a stronger attack.
After using other skills, hold [Basic Attack] to initiate the 3rd hit directly.

special.name: 特殊技：《风铃与旧约》
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】  发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】  发动：
快速位移，随后释放[震音]造成以太伤害，并进入[咏叹华彩]状态；
发动时若拖曳摇杆，可以向对应方向位移；
发动时可长按 【特殊技键】 进行蓄力，持续聚集敌人，并根据蓄力时长追加释放1~4道[震音]；
招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]；
快速位移期间拥有无敌效果。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Quickly move away, then release Tremolo, dealing Ether DMG, and enter the Idyllic Cadenza state.
During activation, dragging the joystick enables movement in the direction held.
Hold [Special Attack] to charge during activation, drawing enemies in, and follow up with 1 to 4 Tremolos depending on the charge duration.
A Quick Assist will be triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable when quickly moving away.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：《折伞华尔兹》
dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方敌人发动攻击，造成以太伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Attack enemies in front, dealing Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chain.name: 连携技：《微醺协奏》
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
chain.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
用歌声引导能量轰击，造成大量以太伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]；
招式发动后，耀嘉音将进入[咏叹华彩]状态。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Use song to channel energy into a blast, dealing massive Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
After the skill, Astra Yao enters the Idyllic Cadenza state.

ultimate.name: 终结技：《幻想式奏鸣》
ultimate.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
ultimate.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
用歌声引导能量轰击，造成大量以太伤害，并为全队角色回复200点生命值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]；
招式发动后，耀嘉音将进入[咏叹华彩]状态；
招式发动后，下两次发动的[快速支援]，将被替换为[连携技]；
次数耗尽前，全队角色[连携技]或[终结技]命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Use song to channel energy into a blast, dealing massive Ether DMG, and restoring 200 HP to all squad members.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
After the skill, Astra Yao enters the Idyllic Cadenza state.
After the skill, the next two Quick Assists will be replaced by Chain Attacks.
Before all replacement chances are used up, a Quick Assist is triggered whenever any squad member hits an enemy with a Chain Attack or Ultimate.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：《一川烟火》
quickAssist.trigger: 当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
quickAssist.triggerEn: When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
向前方敌人发动攻击，造成以太伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Attack enemies in front, dealing Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

defensiveAssist.name: 回避支援：《两份相惜》
defensiveAssist.trigger: 前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
defensiveAssist.triggerEn: When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
defensiveAssist.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
回避敌人的攻击，并触发[极限视域]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
defensiveAssist.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Dodges the enemy's attack and activates Vital View.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.name: 支援突击：《三生初见》
assistFollowup.trigger: 发动[回避支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
assistFollowup.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] after an Evasive Assist to activate:
assistFollowup.description:
发动[回避支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：

招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
assistFollowup.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after an Evasive Assist to activate:
Release an energy beam forward, dealing Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

facts.text: 招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]；
facts.textEn: A Quick Assist will be triggered when this skill hits an enemy.

facts.text:
[咏叹华彩]状态下，耀嘉音拥有[和弦]时，能够在以下情况中触发[快速支援]：
触发[快速支援]后，短时间内点按 【切换键】 切换角色，将触发[精准支援]，耀嘉音会额外追加释放3枚[音簇]进行攻击，队伍中其他角色通过[连携技]、[招架支援]或[回避支援]入场时，将直接触发[精准支援]。
facts.textEn:
While in the Idyllic Cadenza state, when Astra Yao has Chords, a Quick Assist can be triggered in the following situations:
After triggering a Quick Assist, quickly press [Switch] to switch characters and trigger a Precise Assist, causing Astra Yao to follow up with 3 Tone Clusters to attack. When other squad members switch in through a Chain Attack, Defensive Assist, or Evasive Assist, it will automatically trigger a Precise Assist.

facts.text: 招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]；
facts.textEn: A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.

招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]；
次数耗尽前，全队角色[连携技]或[终结技]命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]。
facts.textEn:
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Before all replacement chances are used up, a Quick Assist is triggered whenever any squad member hits an enemy with a Chain Attack or Ultimate.

facts.text: [咏叹华彩]状态下，队伍中其他角色通过[快速支援]、[连携技]、[招架支援]或[回避支援]入场，耀嘉音消耗能量追加释放[震音]进行攻击时，耀嘉音和入场角色的攻击力提升，提升效果等同于耀嘉音初始攻击力的35%，最高不超过1200点，持续20秒，重复触发时延长持续时间，最多不超过30秒。
facts.textEn: During the Idyllic Cadenza state, when other squad members switch in through a Quick Assist, Chain Attack, Defensive Assist, or Evasive Assist, and when Astra Yao expends Energy to release Tremolo to attack, both Astra Yao and the incoming character's ATK are increased. The increase is equal to 35% of Astra Yao's initial ATK, up to a maximum of 1,200. The effect lasts for 20s and can be extended up to 30s with repeated triggers.

cinema.name: 十二平均律
cinema.description: 耀嘉音攻击命中敌人时，目标的全属性伤害抗性降低6%，最多叠加3层，持续30秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；进入战场时，耀嘉音立刻获得1000点喧响值，在勘域模式中此效果180秒内最多触发一次；发动[终结技]时，全队角色各自获得1层[庇佑之音]效果，持续60秒，受到敌方攻击时，将消耗[庇佑之音]并获得无敌效果，持续1秒。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Astra Yao's attack hits an enemy, the target's All-Attribute RES is reduced by 6%, stacking up to 3 times and lasting 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Upon entering the battlefield, Astra Yao immediately gains 1,000 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone Mode. When activating her Ultimate, all squad members gain 1 stack of Song of Protection for 60s. When attacked by an enemy, consume Song of Protection, granting Invulnerability for 1s.

cinema.name: 贪心艺术
cinema.description: [核心被动：《如歌的行板》]中的攻击力提升效果额外提升19%，上限额外提升400点；[咏叹华彩]状态下，队伍中其他角色通过[快速支援]、[连携技]、[招架支援]或[回避支援]入场时，耀嘉音将额外追加释放1道[震音]和3枚[音簇]进行攻击，3秒内最多触发一次。
cinema.descriptionEn: The ATK buff from Core Passive: "Graceful Andante" is further increased by 19%, with an increased maximum of 400. While in the Idyllic Cadenza state, when other squad members switch in through a Quick Assist, Chain Attack, Defensive Assist, or Evasive Assist, Astra Yao will additionally follow up with 1 Tremolo and 3 Tone Clusters to attack. This effect can trigger once every 3s.

cinema.name: 交错五线谱
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 《后颈的碎发》
cinema.description: 发动[连携技]或[终结技]后，15秒内，耀嘉音未拥有[和弦]时也能够触发[快速支援]，且攻击命中敌人时触发[快速支援]的间隔缩短至1秒；[咏叹华彩]状态下，队伍中其他角色通过[快速支援]入场时，将根据自身特性获得不同的增益效果，全队3秒内最多触发一次：[强攻]：下一次[快速支援]重击命中敌人时，额外造成等同于耀嘉音300%攻击力的伤害；[异常]：下一次[快速支援]累积的属性异常积蓄值提升50%；[击破]：下一次[快速支援]造成的失衡值提升50%。
cinema.descriptionEn: After activating a Chain Attack or Ultimate, within 15s, Astra Yao can trigger a Quick Assist even if she does not have Chords. When the attack hits an enemy, the interval for triggering a Quick Assist is reduced to 1s. While in the Idyllic Cadenza state, when other squad members enter the field via a Quick Assist, they will receive different buffs based on their specialty, and this effect can be triggered once every 3s for the entire squad: Attack: The next Quick Assist heavy attack on an enemy will deal extra DMG equal to 300% of Astra Yao's ATK; Anomaly: The next Quick Assist will have 50% increased Anomaly Buildup; Stun: The next Quick Assist will inflict 50% increased Daze.

cinema.name: 绳匠与丝弦
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 我们即是世界
cinema.description: 在[咏叹华彩]状态下释放和追加释放的[震音]和[音簇]的伤害倍率提升至原本的200%，暴击率提升80%；触发[精准支援]时，耀嘉音会自动追加发动蓄力完成后的[普通攻击：《随想曲》]第三段攻击，并使该招式的暴击率提升80%，10秒内最多触发一次。
cinema.descriptionEn: While in the Idyllic Cadenza state, the DMG multiplier for Tremolo and Tone Clusters released or followed up with will increase to 200% of the original, and CRIT Rate is increased by 80%. When triggering a Precise Assist, Astra Yao will automatically follow up with the charged 3rd-hit of Basic Attack: "Capriccio", with a 80% increased CRIT Rate. This effect can trigger once every 10s.

basic.descriptionEn:
While in the Idyllic Cadenza state, press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Release Tremolo forward to attack, dealing Ether DMG.
A Quick Assist will be triggered when this skill hits an enemy.

basic.name: 普通攻击：副歌
basic.description:
[咏叹华彩]状态下，触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动多道[震音]进行攻击，造成大量以太伤害；
招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
basic.descriptionEn:
While in the Idyllic Cadenza state, press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Launch multiple Tremolo attacks at enemies in front, dealing massive Ether DMG.
A Quick Assist will be triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

basic.name: 普通攻击：终曲
basic.description:
[咏叹华彩]状态下，长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方释放[震音]进行攻击，造成以太伤害，并退出[咏叹华彩]状态；
招式发动时，会对自身施加[核心被动：《如歌的行板》]中的增益效果；
能量足够时，会消耗能量追加释放1道[震音]和3枚[音簇]进行攻击，该次[震音]会被视为[强化特殊技]。
basic.descriptionEn:
While in the Idyllic Cadenza state, hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Release Tremolo forward to attack, dealing Ether DMG and exit the Idyllic Cadenza state.
Upon activation of the skill, it grants Astra Yao the buff from Core Passive: "Graceful Andante".
With enough Energy, consumes Energy to follow up with 1 Tremolo and 3 Tone Clusters. This Tremolo attack released is considered an EX Special Attack.

basic.name: 冲刺攻击：《蚀月奏》
basic.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行攻击，造成以太伤害；
发动时若拖曳摇杆，可以向对应方向位移。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Attack ahead, dealing Ether DMG.
When triggered, dragging the joystick allows movement in the corresponding direction.

ex.name: 特殊技：《风铃与旧约》
ex.description:
点按 【特殊技键】  发动：
快速位移，随后释放[震音]造成以太伤害，并进入[咏叹华彩]状态；
发动时若拖曳摇杆，可以向对应方向位移；
发动时可长按 【特殊技键】 进行蓄力，持续聚集敌人，并根据蓄力时长追加释放1~4道[震音]；
招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]；
快速位移期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Quickly move away, then release Tremolo, dealing Ether DMG, and enter the Idyllic Cadenza state.
During activation, dragging the joystick enables movement in the direction held.
Hold [Special Attack] to charge during activation, drawing enemies in, and follow up with 1 to 4 Tremolos depending on the charge duration.
A Quick Assist will be triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable when quickly moving away.

ex.name: 咏叹华彩
ex.description:
耀嘉音进入[咏叹华彩]状态后，全队角色造成的伤害提升9%，全队角色暴击伤害提升8.5%;
[咏叹华彩]状态下，耀嘉音无法移动，但可以点按 【普通攻击键】 发动[普通攻击：间奏]，或点按 【闪避键】 发动闪避，触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 ，可以发动[普通攻击：副歌]；
状态持续期间，耀嘉音的抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%，切换至其他角色后，耀嘉音会继续留在前场，并获得无敌效果，切换回耀嘉音时，则会自动衔接发动[特殊技：《风铃与旧约》]；
状态持续期间，长按 【普通攻击键】 发动[普通攻击：终曲]，或长按 【闪避键】 ，可以退出[咏叹华彩]状态。
ex.descriptionEn:
After entering the Idyllic Cadenza state, Astra Yao increases all squad members' DMG by 9% and CRIT DMG by 8.5%.
While in the Idyllic Cadenza state, Astra Yao cannot move, but pressing [Basic Attack] will activate Basic Attack: Interlude, and pressing [Dodge] will activate a dodge. After triggering a Perfect Dodge, press [Basic Attack] to activate Basic Attack: Chorus.
While in this state, Astra Yao's Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, and the DMG she takes is reduced by 40%. After switching to another character, Astra Yao will remain on the field and become Invulnerable. When switching back to her, she will automatically follow up with Special Attack: "Windchimes & Oaths".
During this state, hold [Basic Attack] to activate Basic Attack: Finale, exiting the Idyllic Cadenza state, or hold [Dodge] to exit the Idyllic Cadenza state directly.

ex.name: 和弦
ex.description:
每拥有25点能量，耀嘉音将拥有1点[和弦]；
[咏叹华彩]状态下，耀嘉音拥有[和弦]时，能够在以下情况中触发[快速支援]：
· 操作中的角色攻击命中敌人时，3秒内最多触发一次；
· 操作中的角色重击命中敌人时，1秒内最多触发一次；
队伍中其他角色通过[快速支援]、[连携技]、[招架支援]或[回避支援]入场时，耀嘉音将消耗25点能量，并追加释放1道[震音]进行攻击，该次[震音]会被视为[强化特殊技]；
触发[快速支援]后，短时间内点按 【切换键】 切换角色，将触发[精准支援]，耀嘉音会额外追加释放3枚[音簇]进行攻击，队伍中其他角色通过[连携技]、[招架支援]或[回避支援]入场时，将直接触发[精准支援]。
ex.descriptionEn:
For every 25 Energy, Astra Yao will have 1 Chord.
While in the Idyllic Cadenza state, when Astra Yao has Chords, a Quick Assist can be triggered in the following situations:
· When the active character's attack hits an enemy, once per 3s.
· When the active character's heavy attack hits an enemy, once per 1s.
When other squad members switch in through a Quick Assist, Chain Attack, Defensive Assist, or Evasive Assist, Astra Yao will consume 25 Energy and release 1 Tremolo to attack. This Tremolo attack released is considered an EX Special Attack.
After triggering a Quick Assist, quickly press [Switch] to switch characters and trigger a Precise Assist, causing Astra Yao to follow up with 3 Tone Clusters to attack. When other squad members switch in through a Chain Attack, Defensive Assist, or Evasive Assist, it will automatically trigger a Precise Assist.

ultimate.name: 终结技：《幻想式奏鸣》
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
用歌声引导能量轰击，造成大量以太伤害，并为全队角色回复200点生命值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]；
招式发动后，耀嘉音将进入[咏叹华彩]状态；
招式发动后，下两次发动的[快速支援]，将被替换为[连携技]；
次数耗尽前，全队角色[连携技]或[终结技]命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Use song to channel energy into a blast, dealing massive Ether DMG, and restoring 200 HP to all squad members.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
After the skill, Astra Yao enters the Idyllic Cadenza state.
After the skill, the next two Quick Assists will be replaced by Chain Attacks.
Before all replacement chances are used up, a Quick Assist is triggered whenever any squad member hits an enemy with a Chain Attack or Ultimate.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：《一川烟火》
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
向前方敌人发动攻击，造成以太伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Attack enemies in front, dealing Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

1311-core-15.descriptionEn: During the Idyllic Cadenza state, when other squad members switch in through a Quick Assist, Chain Attack, Defensive Assist, or Evasive Assist, and if Astra Yao expends Energy to release Tremolo to attack, both Astra Yao and the incoming character's ATK are increased. The increase is equal to 22% of Astra Yao's initial ATK, up to a maximum of 1,200. The effect lasts for 20s and can be extended up to 30s with repeated triggers.
